labels.label: bzdef:c1s3d2_automorphisme_compatible

hypotheses.note: p = 2, both of dimension a (a conical isomorphism F(B_σ(i)) ≅ F(B_i) forces equal dimensions; with unequal dimensions only σ = id occurs)

questions: « un automorphisme φ de la structure conique affine du produit » is used through its base map only: f is compatible when f[m₁, m₂] = μ·[φ₁ m_{σ(1)}, φ₂ m_{σ(2)}]; that φ is itself a conical automorphism of the product is not required (it is, but nothing uses it).
A conical isomorphism F(B_σ(i)) ≅ F(B_i) can only exist when dim B_σ(i) = dim B_i, so σ ranges over dimension-preserving permutations (a reading, not a finding).
